g.text: Can failure occur with both direct charges removed?
Campaign 019: all 40 worlds. Movement charge is zero; four initial treatments per matched seed.
Free birth still splits energy and adds future basal demand. Every seed and failure is retained.
Finite-horizon outcomes do not establish permanent survival or a unique causal mediator.
